en.ammaar-muslim: 5. [5/50] al-Khisal: From my father from Sa’d from al-Barqi from al-Hasan b. Ali b. Fadhal from Tha’laba from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام who said:
men are of three kinds: a man by his wealth, a man by his position, and a man by his tongue (good speaker), and he is the best of the three.
